issue: The add(a, b) function returns the wrong result. Fix it without changing its public signature. Run the tests.
slugify(title) should return a lowercase slug and collapse runs of spaces into one hyphen. Preserve the public function signature. Run the tests.
parse_line must split at the first '=' only, because the value can contain additional '=' characters. Keep its return type and run the tests.
page(items, page_number, page_size) uses one-based page numbers. Return the correct slice for the first, middle, and final partial page. Preserve the signature and run the tests.

retry(operation, max_attempts) must call the operation at most max_attempts times, return its first success, and re-raise the last error after all attempts fail. Reject nonpositive max_attempts. Run the tests.
unique_in_order(items) must remove duplicate strings while preserving their first-seen order. Handle empty input and keep the return type. Run the tests.
median(values) must return the middle value for odd-length inputs and the arithmetic mean of the two middle values for even-length inputs. Keep empty-input rejection and run the tests.
build_query(params) must URL-encode both keys and values in insertion order, using application/x-www-form-urlencoded rules (spaces become '+'). Empty input returns an empty string. Run the tests.

reserve(stock, request) must return a new stock mapping and leave the input unchanged. Reject unknown SKUs, negative quantities, and quantities above available stock, including unknown SKUs requested with zero quantity. Run the tests.
extension(filename) must return the lowercase final suffix without its dot. A dotfile alone, trailing dot, or name without a dot has no extension. Run the tests.
